notes.title: Cranked Up - Some news
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545880/13720c39022616b04a092aa759b5f83316f20da7.png[/img]


[h2]Hello everyone, after a few months without news, we finally come back to you.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545880/0455af89371b50fb03b296a37936a94fdebefb07.gif[/img]

[u][h3]Where are we now?[/h3][/u]
Despite our desire to share with you a game experience that we wanted to be frustrating but fair, where the only catch of the game would be its cute art direction [i](the famous "Cute & difficult")[/i], we didn't succeed in finding our audience. And this, although various playtests during the development were very encouraging.

This mishap made us want to deliver what we think is a good game. Before explaining what we changed, here are some constraints we had to face...

[u][h3]A bit of context.[/h3][/u]
Due to the low sales and wishlists of the game, our cash flow did not go in the right direction and we had to redirect to some side missions in order to finish Cranked Up. 
We still wanted to provide the best experience possible, so going back to the development of Cranked Up, we spent a lot of time on the multiplayer as well as other new biomes.
We did a lot of iterations, but the result felt too rough for the quality we were looking for and got the better of that part of the game.

Along the way we also had to reduce the size of our team [i](they all found work back)[/i] but we are now down to two and the amount of work we can do is reduced.

We finally took the time to step back and came up with the following...

[b]Let's finish the project, learn from our mistakes and bounce back.[/b]

[u][h3]And Cranked Up in concrete terms?[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] We have removed the different multiplayer modes.
[*] There will be only two biomes, which allow you to make the most of the trial and the floor is lava modes.

[*] The selling price of the game will drop.
[*] The controller is facilitated, although the mode that we had imagined is still present. [i]( Already present in the last maj )[/i]
[*] The camera brings a better readability and more dynamism.
[*] The overall balance of the game is improved.
[*] Most of the bugs are fixed.
[*] A little optimization.
[/list]
[i]We thank all those who have followed us so far, whether they have given us feedback or not. We give you [b]rendez-vous in the coming months for the release of Cranked Up[/b] hoping that you will like these adjustments. If you want to support us, don't hesitate to talk about the game :)

Also, don't hesitate to continue to follow us so that we can share with you our future creations, hoping that you will like them and entertain you.[/i]

Thanks to you, love and sweetness <3

notes.title: Open Beta available!
notes.notes:
[h1]Watch out! [/h1]
[h3]The Beta of Cranked Up is an experimental version. [/h3]
We hope you will enjoy the contents of this Beta version, especially the [b][u]multiplayer[/u][/b] which remains a complex issue especially regarding some balancing.

[h1]How to Play Open Beta[/h1]
[olist]
[*] [b]Right click[/b] on Cranked Up in your Steam library
[*] Go to [b]"Properties..."[/b]
[*] Click on the [b]"BETAS"[/b] tab
[*] Selected [b]"betatest"[/b] from the dropdown
[/olist]
And voila!
Welcome to the Beta players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545880/35561b41f6680878b3b5bf82b177cfa152fa555a.gif[/img]

[h1]Multiplayer modes[/h1]

[h3][b][u]Main[/u]:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][u]Versus[/u]: (2-4P)[/b] Compete 2-4 players in a three-round time trial to win.
[*] [b][u]Coop[/u]: (2P)[/b] It's a more relaxed experience mixing platform and puzzle phases. [i](Playable as a pair only.)[/i]
[/list]
[h3][b][u]Experimental[/u]:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][u]Spring[/u]: (2-4P)[/b] All players are attached to their neighbors by a rubber band. Try to play it to pull, tow or propel yourself further forward!
[*] [b][u]One Legged[/u]: (2P)[/b] Cooperative mode where each player controls 1 rocket on 2. Beware of dizziness! [i](Playable as a pair only.)[/i]
[*] [b][u]Handlebar[/u]: (2P)[/b] You are connected to each other by a handlebar. If you want to move forward, the movements must be synchronized. [i](Playable as a pair only.)[/i]
[*] [b][u]Versus[/u]: (2P)[/b] In splitscreens, first one will wins. Donut collisions enabled! [i](Playable as a pair only.)[/i]
[/list]

[h3][b]Warning![/b][/h3]
[b]The game works with the use of [u]Steam Remote Play Together[/u]. For a better experience it is recommended to play the game locally.[/b]

[h1]Coming up[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b][u]Biome 3[/u]:[/b] The game currently includes the 2 biomes "City" & "Western". The next biome will first be available on the Beta branch. We will inform you more details soon.
[/list]

notes.title: Cranked Up devlog #2
notes.notes:
[h1]We Cranked Up the dev![/h1]

To make sure that we're heading in the right direction, we organized a playtest session at ArtFX school in Montpellier.

[h2]Why playtesting?[/h2]

it's simple several aspects of the game needed to be tested:

[list]
[*] Different controllers
[*] Different game modes
[*] Our database 
[/list]

[h2]What was our organization?[/h2]

The playtests were divided in 2 session of 1 hour each.

[b]1. Welcoming playtesters[/b] [i]10min[/i]
Setup 
NDA
Team presentation

[b]2. Session 1/2[/b] [i]30min[/i] 
Playtesters were divided in 2 categories (controller A and controller B) 10min
Playtesters swapped controllers (A take B and vice-versa) 5min
Playtesters choose their favorite controller to finish the session 15min

[b]3. Session 2/2[/b] [i]15min[/i]
Playtesters, choose controllers, they also choose to test multiplayer or hardcore/challenging solo game modes.

[b]4. Session end[/b] [i]10min[/i]
Playtesters answer to a google form, and ask question to the team.

In the same time each member of the team had to wright down their impression on the test, and take a look to the database.

We had a great time and the session was a blast, make sure to [b]follow us on social medias[/b] for the next one, here some pictures to wait:
